name: Superset
summary: Desktop workspace for orchestrating many CLI coding agents in parallel, each task in an isolated Git worktree.
description: A local-first desktop app (macOS; experimental Linux AppImage) that runs CLI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode side by side, each task in its own Git worktree and branch. Automations run prompts on a schedule, and a CLI, TypeScript SDK and MCP server allow programmatic control.
contains: one workspace for any CLI coding agent: Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot, Cursor Agent
each task runs in an isolated Git worktree with its own branch
scheduled automations: issue triage, changelog drafts, dependency bumps
remote hosts: workspaces keep running when your laptop sleeps
CLI, TypeScript SDK and MCP server, plus installable agent skills
macOS today, experimental Linux AppImage, Windows not yet available
free tier plus paid seats at $15/user/month billed yearly, and an enterprise plan
